version.changelog: Add Step 6.5: archive text+image+audio to replay library; require copying scene/route image into outbound for reliable re-listen/continue

llm.summary: This is mostly a disclosed daily reading skill, but it asks the agent to run an unverified local audio helper script and to persist or send generated outputs, so it needs careful review before installation.

dimensions.detail: Reading bundled text and writing progress/media files are proportionate for the stated purpose, but executing bash against a mutable workspace-controlled audio helper is broader than needed and outside the package review boundary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time script, dependency install, remote payload fetch, or package lifecycle execution was found in package metadata or the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: State changes and delivery are only partly scoped. The skill uses generic triggers such as 'xuanzang' and 'xiyuji', can advance persistent progress, copy media into shared OpenClaw outbound storage, and send Telegram media without consistently requiring explicit confirmation for those actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally persists progress under ~/.openclaw/workspace/daily-xuanzang and generated replay assets under ~/.openclaw/media/outbound; it also suggests scheduled cron or heartbeat delivery, though it does not itself install a service or backdoor.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core purpose is coherent: read bundled Xuanzang source text, generate lectures, maps, and optional voice, and track progress. The main concern is that voice generation recommends running a workspace or home-directory shell script that is not included in the reviewed artifact; volume 12 also contains reachable donation/payment text outside the canonical reading material.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with local progress/media persistence and scheduled delivery. Before enabling voice, remove the external bash-helper instruction or replace it with a bundled, reviewed, fixed-path helper; use explicit trigger phrases and confirmation before advancing progress or posting to channels; prune or guard the vol12 donation section so it is not narrated as source text.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: translation, maps, and voice are implemented as agent workflow instructions rather than Python code, so the narrower progress.py script is not by itself a deceptive capability mismatch.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: trigger phrases include generic terms that could invoke a stateful daily-reading workflow during ordinary discussion.
[LP3] expected: Accepted as a scoping concern: local bundled reads and progress/media writes are expected, but the artifact does not constrain permissions or paths beyond documentation.
[SQP-2] expected: Downgraded: progress persistence and its path are disclosed, but clearer first-run consent and confirmation before advancing would reduce ambiguity.
[SQP-3] expected: Mostly downgraded: Chinese and English output are central to the skill and user-visible, while historical source passages with biased ethnographic language should be contextualized rather than treated as active policy or instructions.
[TT2] expected: Downgraded: the read/write flow is ordinary JSON progress-state persistence, not evidence of unsafe data movement by itself.
[T09] unexpected: Accepted as material: SKILL.md recommends running bash on <WORKSPACE>/scripts/xuanzang-audio.sh or a home-directory reference path, but that helper is not bundled or integrity-checked.
[other] unexpected: Accepted as low-impact content-integrity risk: donation and payment material at the end of vol12.txt can be extracted as if it were reading text, but no automatic payment or credential submission is implemented.
